# Xenobiology Xenobiology is breeding slimes and harvesting their extracts. It is more dangerous than it looks.
## Getting started Research [color=#a4885c]Xenobiology[/color] in the Experimental tree to print a slime grinder board, a xenobiological bounty console board, a slime scanner and a xenovac. Cargo sells a starter crate with two grey slimes, a scanner and a xenovac.
## Feeding Slimes eat anything: food, monkeys, and you. They latch onto other creatures and slowly digest them. One monkey is enough for a baby slime to grow into an adult.
Pet a slime to tame it. A tamed slime only goes for you when it is grown and very hungry, and its offspring stay tame.
Once an adult is well fed it shakes, then splits into one to four babies. Each baby may mutate into a new colour. Scan a slime to see its mutation chance and what it can become.
## Help, a slime is on my face! Pull it off, have someone xenovac you, or kill it.
## Moving slimes The xenovac sucks slimes into its backpack tank. Click the floor with the nozzle to blow them all back out.
## Culling Water hurts slimes; a fire extinguisher or a shower kills them quickly. A dead slime goes flat.
## Grinding Drag a dead slime onto a powered slime grinder. It spits out the slime's extracts after a moment.
## Extracts Inject an extract with a reagent to set it off. Most react to plasma, water or blood; the scanner tells you which. Some make a reagent inside the extract, some make items, some do something nasty. Experiment!
## Bounties The xenobiological bounty console asks for extracts and pays research points to its research server.
